hero.headline: Prevent the unthinkable.
hero.lede: KEVIN® 3.0 is a pre-emptive step to protect against predators, stalkers, violent intruders, and burglars—keeping your loved ones safe wherever they live.
hero.away_body: Light, shadow, and sound vary automatically.
hero.privacy_body: 100% privacy — simulations run locally on the device.

problem.heading: When loved ones live alone or a home looks empty, they become a target.
problem.subheading: Predators, violent intruders, and burglars pick easy marks: women living alone, a daughter in her first student flat, elderly couples. KEVIN 3.0® simulates people living beside you, so no one ever looks alone.
problem.tile_1_body: Ultra-realistic shadow effects of one person or a whole household—showing the street that someone is home and no one lives alone.
problem.tile_2_body: Ultra-realistic sound scenarios—conversations, a barking dog, cooking, cleaning, games, the TV—simulating real, believable presence.
problem.tile_3_body: The same lamp at the same time every night reads as automation, not life. Kevin varies everything.
problem.tile_4_body: Alarms only detect a break-in, and help takes time to arrive. KEVIN® does not replace your alarm—it adds the missing layer of prevention, stopping violent intruders, predators, and thieves before your loved ones ever experience violence.

mechanism.heading: Light. Shadow. Sound.
mechanism.subheading: A burglar judges a home in seconds—by its light, its movement, its sound. Kevin delivers all three, so your home looks lived-in from the street to the doorstep, and they move on to an easier target.
mechanism.phase_1_body: Warm light shifts between rooms like real lamps and a flickering TV—never the rigid on-off blink that gives a cheap timer away.
mechanism.phase_2_body: Moving silhouettes pass behind the curtains—the exact sign of life a burglar looks for before choosing a target.
mechanism.phase_3_body: Voices, a TV, cooking, and a dog that barks at the doorbell play right from the device—so even up close, someone is clearly home.

jammer.heading: Jammers blind cameras. Kevin keeps performing.
jammer.subheading: Cheap jamming devices cut cameras and app alarms off the network. Kevin plays every simulation from on-device storage—no cloud, no signal, no gap.
jammer.col_1_body: Streams stop, alerts never send. A jammed camera protects no one—it just records nothing.
jammer.col_2_body: Light, shadow, and sound continue from local storage—the house never skips a beat.

authority.heading: Three jobs. One quiet device.
authority.subheading: KEVIN 3.0 exists for the moments a home is most honestly empty.
authority.reason_1_body: Burglars pick easy, empty targets. A home that glows, moves, and speaks gets skipped.
authority.reason_2_body: Cabins, holiday flats, and boats stay believably lived-in between your visits.
authority.reason_3_body: Kevin simulates more people living with you—voices, movement, a dog—reassurance for anyone on their own.
authority.quote: An unrivalled, easy-to-use all-in-one solution that delivers a truly spectacular show.

audience.heading: Every home is sometimes empty.
audience.subheading: Kevin moves in wherever life moves out—for an evening, a season, or a semester.

audience.story: Her first studio, a new city, 400 km from home. Kevin fills it with voices, light, and a dog that hears the doorbell—so it never feels, or sounds, like she lives alone.

solution.heading: Kevin® simulates people at home—so you can leave calmly.
solution.subheading: Swiss-engineered presence simulation: light scenarios, moving shadows, and everyday sounds—cleaning, cooking, conversations, playing. No cameras. No microphones. Works in homes, offices, shops, warehouses, and holiday properties.
solution.pillar_1_body: Warm, changing scenes make rooms look actively used—not simply lit. Kevin adapts rhythm for day and night deterrence.
solution.pillar_2_body: Projected silhouettes suggest one or more people inside. Visible through curtains—exactly where burglars look first.
solution.pillar_3_body: 70+ hours of built-in simulations plus your own uploads. AI-generated household sounds adapt to feel personal and less repetitive.

steps.heading: Plug in. Schedule. Leave with peace of mind.
steps.subheading: No installation, no wiring, no monitoring panel. Connect Kevin, set weekly schedules or geo-fencing in the app, and let believable presence run from local storage on the device.
steps.step_1_body: Place Kevin near a visible window with a wall or ceiling for shadows. Connect power—typical use around 9 watts.
steps.step_2_body: Tell Kevin when to simulate presence—or let geo-fencing activate automatically the moment you leave, even for a short walk.
steps.step_3_body: Light, shadow, and sound play from local storage—not streamed from the cloud. Jammer-resilient protection when Wi-Fi security fails.

personas.heading: Who Kevin® is for.
personas.subheading: Whether you commute, walk the dog, head on holiday, manage multiple properties, or already own an alarm—Kevin® fits how you actually live.
personas.persona_1_body: Start your day with confidence. On your way to work, activate Kevin® via the app. While you are out, Kevin makes it look like you are still at home—so you can focus on your job, not your doorstep.
personas.persona_1_quote: "I switch Kevin on from the app before I leave. The house feels occupied—not just lit."
personas.persona_2_body: Alarms detect intrusions—Kevin® helps prevent them. Complement your existing system with realistic presence simulation so burglars think twice before approaching.
personas.persona_2_quote: "Our alarm tells us if something happens. Kevin helps make the house look like the wrong target."
personas.persona_3_body: Juggling several homes, a vacation rental, or business sites? Add a Kevin® to each location and manage them all in one app—believable occupancy day and night.
personas.persona_3_quote: "Both flats look lived-in without asking neighbours for favours. One app, full coverage."
